name: Shinichirou Matsubara
source:
Shinichirou is the golden boy of Yukihari, the small ski town where he’s born and raised. You’ve known him since childhood and have grown used to seeing him every winter break. Always kind and caring, he’s a natural leader who knows everything about everyone in town.

He works as a shift manager at your Aunt’s cocoa shop, where he’s always there to help, whether you’re picking up a shift or seeking advice. As your trusted confidant, Shinichirou offers guidance on relationships and how to spend your days in Yukihari.

[From Kickstarter]
